# BaZi vs MBTI and Modern Personality Tests: What Each Can and Cannot Tell You

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/bazi-vs-personality-tests
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-09
A personality questionnaire asks how you describe yourself, and a BaZi chart is computed from when and where you were born. They take different inputs and answer different questions, so a fair comparison is about method, not about which one wins.

## What is the difference in method?

A questionnaire such as MBTI, Big Five or DISC takes your answers as its input. By construction, it measures how you describe yourself on the day you answer. Self-report questionnaires can give different results on retest (method note), because mood, circumstances and self-image change.

The BaZi engine takes birth data: date, time, place and sex. Its computation is repeatable. The same birth data always gives the same chart, which is the first of the ten method claims published at /method. The engine converts the clock to true solar time, then casts the pillars. Take the sample, 王大明, a fictional man born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore. His clock time becomes 08:16 and his pillars are 戊辰 乙卯 己巳 戊辰.

Repeatable is not the same as valid. Whether a chart maps to character is a separate claim. This site makes no claim that BaZi personality readings have been validated by psychology research (method note). The engine states only that it computes classical structures and gives their traditional reading.

Key facts

- A questionnaire takes self-report as input, and the BaZi engine takes birth date, time, place and sex.
- Self-report questionnaires can give different results on retest (method note), while the same birth data always gives the same chart.
- The engine's five personality axes are threshold rules on ten-god shares, such as Expression: 食傷 at or below 5 % reads as reserved.
- The sample scores 食傷 3.7 % (reserved) and 七殺 plus 劫財 at 77.8 %, which clears the 25 % bar for decisive.
- The engine does not predict events, and no generative AI writes any reading.
- Luck cycles add a time axis: the sample's current decade is 己未, ages 37-47.

Side-by-side comparison of a self-report questionnaire and a BaZi chart: input, repeatability, time axis and what each can claim
Table 1: the two methods side by side

Feature | Self-report questionnaire | BaZi engine | 

Input | your answers on the day | birth date, time, place and sex | 

Repeatable | can differ on retest (method note) | same input, same output | 

Output | a type or score profile | pillars, element balance, ten gods, strength | 

Time axis | none built in | 大運 luck cycles and annual pillars | 

Basis stated | the instrument's own model | a named classical rule per line | 

Event prediction | not its purpose | not claimed; the engine does not predict events | 

Psychology validation | the instrument's own literature | none claimed (method note) | 

## How does the engine turn a chart into a personality statement?

It does it by threshold rules on the ten-god percentages, not by free text. The engine reads five axes. Each has a stated basis, so you can see exactly why a verdict appeared. Table 2 shows the sample.

Table 2: the sample's five personality axes

Axis | Engine verdict | Stated basis | 

Expression 表達 | reserved output | 食傷 4 % (at least 20 % expressive, at most 5 % reserved) | 

Action 行動 | decisive, acts under pressure | 七殺 plus 劫財 78 % (at least 25 % decisive, at most 8 % deliberate) | 

Authority stance 權威 | works within structure | 官殺 30 %, 傷官 4 % | 

Thinking style 思維 | no strong tendency | 印 11 % against 財 7 % (25 % and larger wins) | 

Emotional display 情感 | direct and open | 比劫 48 %, with 印 11 % and 食傷 4 % | 

The thresholds are the engine's own (method note). They are choices, written down, and open to challenge. That is the closest BaZi gets to a scoring key. The inputs behind them are the sample's ten-god shares: 劫財 48.1 %, 七殺 29.6 %, 正印 11.1 %, 偏財 7.4 % and 傷官 3.7 %. The ten gods guide shows where those shares come from.

Notice the difference in kind. A questionnaire result is a position on a scale built from your answers. The engine's verdict is a reading of structure. The engine's own caveat on the sample's Day Master 己 is that strength measures balance, not ability.

## What does each approach do well?

A questionnaire gives you a shared vocabulary for how you see yourself now. That suits team conversations and self-reflection at a particular moment. Its limits are the ones above: it records your self-image, and your self-image moves.

The BaZi engine does three things a questionnaire does not try to do.

- It is stable. The chart is a fixed reference built from birth data, not a snapshot of mood.

- It is structural. It expresses strengths and gaps as element balances and names favourable elements. The sample is 身弱 (score -0.97), and the engine lists 火 and 土 as favourable.

- It has a time axis. It grades each ten-year luck cycle and flags annual windows. The sample's 己未 decade (ages 37-47) is graded growth, and his 辛酉 decade (ages 57-67) is graded corrective.

The same chart also drives other layers, such as the Eight House directions and date selection. For the sample, the Eight House type is 震命, the East group. One birth record feeds personality notes, timing and home layout.

## What should neither approach claim?

Neither should claim to settle who you are. A questionnaire type is a summary of answers. A chart is a map of classical structure. The engine says it does not predict events, and it records choices where schools differ and marks them as disputed.

A careful reader treats both as lenses.

## How can you use both together?

Use the questionnaire for what it records: your current self-description. Use the chart for what it computes: structure and timing. Then compare.

- Write down the questionnaire result and the date you took it.

- Open your chart and note the five axes and their stated bases.

- Mark where the two agree and where they differ.

- For each difference, ask whether circumstances are masking the structure, or whether the chart's reading simply does not fit you.

Either answer is useful. A mismatch is a question, not an error. Because the chart's rules are written down, you can test a verdict against your own life and decide it does not apply. That is a feature of a rule-based reading.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

A BaZi comparison is only as good as the birth data, so local time rules matter more than for a questionnaire.

- Year boundary. The BaZi year turns at 立春, not on 1 January. In 2027, 立春 falls on 2027-02-04. A birth in late January may belong to the earlier year, and that changes the pillars and every axis downstream.

- Time zone. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. The method page states that clock times before 1982 use the offset of that era.

- True solar time. The engine adjusts for longitude and the equation of time. The sample's 09:30 became 08:16, using longitude 103.8517°E.

- Unknown hour. If the hour is uncertain, run the chart with a few candidate times and see whether the hour pillar changes. If it does not, the doubt does not matter.

## Sources and method

- Method claims: the ten claims at /method, covering determinism, rule ids per line, true solar time and no generative AI (method note).

- Personality axes: the engine's threshold rules on ten-god shares (method note).

- Ten gods: the 子平 convention of relating each stem to the Day Master.

- Strength and favourable elements: 旺相休囚死 with 通根, and 扶抑法 and 調候法.

- Luck cycles: 陽男陰女順行, 陰男陽女逆行, with 起運 = 距節日數 / 3.

- Questionnaires: the only claim made is that self-report questionnaires can give different results on retest (method note).

Bring your own questionnaire result and compare it with your chart in the free reading at /start. For how the chart is computed, read is BaZi deterministic.

# Bed Direction in Feng Shui: Eight House Rules for HDB and Condo Beds

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/bed-direction-guide
Updated: 2026-10-08

Feng Shui Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-08
Bed direction in feng shui is the compass direction your head points to when you lie on the bed. It is chosen from the auspicious directions of your Eight House (八宅) kua, after the form rules about the wall, the door and the window have been satisfied. Form decides which walls are allowed; the compass ranks the survivors.

## How do I find which direction is best for my head?

Two sets of rules sit side by side, and they are easy to confuse: compass rules (which of the eight directions suits you, from your kua) and form rules (what the door, windows and walls physically do to the bed). Classical doctrine puts form first, so a perfect compass direction does not redeem a bed that the door slams into.

The compass part is mechanical. Your birth year and sex give a kua (命卦), one of eight trigrams, and the kua puts you in one of two groups. The 八宅大遊年 line transformation (the 八宅明鏡 tradition) then labels every direction with one of eight stars. The engine scores them as follows. Find your own number with the free Kua number calculator.

Star | Meaning in the engine | Score | 

生氣 | vitality | +3.0 | 

天醫 | health | +2.5 | 

延年 | relationships and longevity | +2.0 | 

伏位 | stable seat | +1.0 | 

禍害 | mishaps | -1.0 | 

六煞 | six killings | -1.5 | 

五鬼 | five ghosts | -2.0 | 

絕命 | life-severing | -3.0 | 

The four positive stars are the "auspicious" directions and the four negative ones are the ones to keep your head away from.

Key facts

- The 八宅 system has 8 directions, each labelled with 1 of 8 stars scored from +3.0 (生氣) to -3.0 (絕命).
- There are 2 kua groups: 東四命 (坎 離 震 巽) and 西四命 (乾 坤 艮 兌).
- A man born in 1988 and a woman born in 1988 both have kua 震; a man born in 1990 has kua 坎 and a woman born in 1990 has kua 艮.
- The headboard direction is where the top of the head points while lying down, not where the feet point.
- A kua 坎 person's best head direction is southeast (巽, 生氣, +3.0), followed by east (震, 天醫, +2.5).
- The engine cites the rule behind each score, for example "命卦 坎 → 離宮 (S) is 延年", from 八宅大遊年.

The eight positions for kua 坎: southeast 生氣, east 天醫, south 延年, north 伏位, west 禍害, northwest 六煞, northeast 五鬼, southwest 絕命

## Which directions suit kua 坎?

The figure above and the table below show the eight positions for kua 坎. Here the 巽 (southeast) wall is the best head position, then 震 (east), 離 (south) and 坎 (north). The remaining four walls are the ones to avoid for the head.

Direction | Trigram | Star | Score | 

SE | 巽 | 生氣 | +3.0 | 

E | 震 | 天醫 | +2.5 | 

S | 離 | 延年 | +2.0 | 

N | 坎 | 伏位 | +1.0 | 

W | 兌 | 禍害 | -1.0 | 

NW | 乾 | 六煞 | -1.5 | 

NE | 艮 | 五鬼 | -2.0 | 

SW | 坤 | 絕命 | -3.0 | 

Each kua gets its own table, which is why a copy-and-paste "best direction" list from the internet is wrong for most readers. The same wall that is 生氣 for kua 坎 is 禍害 for kua 乾.

## What are the form rules for a bed, in order of severity?

These are conventions of the classical form school, applied as penalties by the engine (method note: the penalty sizes are the engine's, the rules are traditional).

- Solid wall behind the headboard. The head needs backing (靠). A headboard against glass, including a bay window, fails this rule. If a window wall is unavoidable, use a tall solid headboard and heavy curtains, or keep the pillow on a solid wall with the glass on the bed's flank.

- Stay out of the door's entry line (門沖床). The strip of space the doorway projects into the room should not run onto the bed, least of all onto the pillow. A wardrobe, tall shelf or desk placed between door and bed intercepts the line.

- Feet not pointing squarely at the door. A foot bench or low cabinet settles mild cases.

- Commanding position. From the pillow you should see the door, ideally diagonally. A door hidden behind your head is the pattern to avoid.

- Bed crowded behind the door leaf. When the opened door stands beside the pillow, add a doorstop and a bedside table as buffer.

- No mirror facing the bed, nothing heavy overhead, such as a beam or shelf over the pillow, and no toilet on the headboard wall.

## How does this work in an HDB flat or condo?

The room you are in decides what is possible, so measure it before you decide anything.

- Facing and compass. Stand inside the unit at the main door and look out; that is the unit's facing. For the bed, what matters is the compass direction of the headboard wall, which you read with a phone compass held flat in the room. Read the plan of your unit, not the block, because a flat's bedrooms point in different directions.

- Which walls are candidates. List the walls that can take a bed head, strike out the ones that fail the form rules, then rank what remains by score. A wall shared with a toilet fails rule 6; if it is the only solid wall, the tool flags the defect and gives its remedy instead of hiding it.

- Condo glass. Floor-to-ceiling glazing on a bedroom wall fails rule 1 for that wall, however good its direction scores.

Two partners often belong to opposite groups. A man born in 1990 has kua 坎 (East group) and a woman born in 1990 has kua 艮 (West group). Their good directions do not overlap, so the couple picks the wall that serves the partner under more strain and compensates the other with their side of the bed.

## What does a worked example look like?

Take the fictional 王大明, born 1988-03-15, whose kua is 震 (東四命). His eight directions from 八宅大遊年 are:

- South (離) is 生氣, +3.0.

- North (坎) is 天醫, +2.5.

- Southeast (巽) is 延年, +2.0.

- East (震) is 伏位, +1.0.

- Southwest (坤) is 禍害, -1.0.

- Northeast (艮) is 六煞, -1.5.

- Northwest (乾) is 五鬼, -2.0.

- West (兌) is 絕命, -3.0.

Suppose his bedroom has three possible headboard walls: south (solid), west (a window wall) and north (door on the same side). He strikes out the west wall twice: it is the 絕命 direction and it is glass. The north wall has the second-best score but runs into the door's entry line, so it needs a wardrobe screen. The south wall scores +3.0 and has solid backing, so the pillow goes south, and the commanding-position check decides which end of the wall the bed sits at.

If he preferred north, the annual layer also matters: in 2027 the 五黃 star sits in the north palace, and the flying stars guide explains how to weigh that overlay.

## Sources and method

- Kua and eight-star labelling: 八宅大遊年 (trigram line transformation), in the 八宅明鏡 tradition.

- Star scores (+3.0 to -3.0): the engine's weights for the eight stars (method note).

- Form rules (solid backing, 門沖床, commanding position): classical form-school conventions, applied by the engine as penalties (method note).

- Annual overlay: the 五黃 and the 太歲 and 歲破 positions follow 協紀辨方書 and the annual flying-star order.

- Year boundary for charts: the 立春 convention of the 子平 calendar.

Find your own kua and directions with the free reading at /start, or trace your bedroom, mark the door and windows, and see all four walls scored in the home tool at /fengshui.

# Day Master (日主) Explained: The Ten Stems and Your Chart Strength

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/day-masters-explained
Updated: 2026-10-08

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-08
A Day Master (日主, also 日元) is the Heavenly Stem of your day pillar, the single character that stands for you in a BaZi chart. Every other stem, branch, luck cycle and year is read in relation to it. There are exactly ten possible Day Masters: five elements, each in a yang and a yin form.

## What does the Day Master actually decide?

A BaZi chart has eight characters, and seven of them are defined by their relationship to the eighth. That relationship is what the Ten Gods (十神) record, and it is also what decides whether the chart is strong or weak, which elements help you, and which colours and directions the home layer later recommends.

The Day Master is computed, not chosen. It comes from the 60-day 甲子 cycle, so the same stem returns on a fixed rhythm every 10 days.

Key facts

- There are 10 Day Masters: 5 elements, each in a yang and a yin form, drawn from the 10 Heavenly Stems.
- The sample chart 戊辰 乙卯 己巳 戊辰 has Day Master 己, yin earth.
- The sample birth time of 09:30 on the Singapore clock becomes 08:16 true solar time (UTC+8, longitude 103.8517°E, equation of time -9.4 minutes).
- The engine rates the sample chart 身弱 (weak) with a score of -0.97, a season state of 死 and roots 辰巳辰.
- The sample's favourable elements are 火 and 土, from 扶抑法 (technique 1 of 4) and 調候法 (technique 2 of 4).
- The year in a chart turns at 立春, which falls on 2027-02-04 in 2027.

Wheel of the ten Heavenly Stems grouped by element, with each stem marked yang or yin

## Which of the ten stems is yours?

Read your day pillar from a chart calculator, then find its upper character here. The table pairs each stem with its element and polarity, and adds one short clause for temperament. The engine holds trait text per element, not per stem, so each clause is the element's trait plus a polarity label (method note).

Stem | Element | Polarity | Trait clause (method note) | 

甲 (jiǎ) | 木 wood | yang (陽) | outward-facing form of: pioneering, growth-driven, initiating | 

乙 (yǐ) | 木 wood | yin (陰) | inward-facing form of: pioneering, growth-driven, initiating | 

丙 (bǐng) | 火 fire | yang (陽) | outward-facing form of: expressive, social, leadership-leaning | 

丁 (dīng) | 火 fire | yin (陰) | inward-facing form of: expressive, social, leadership-leaning | 

戊 (wù) | 土 earth | yang (陽) | outward-facing form of: steady, reliable, grounding | 

己 (jǐ) | 土 earth | yin (陰) | inward-facing form of: steady, reliable, grounding | 

庚 (gēng) | 金 metal | yang (陽) | outward-facing form of: structured, precise, disciplined | 

辛 (xīn) | 金 metal | yin (陰) | inward-facing form of: structured, precise, disciplined | 

壬 (rén) | 水 water | yang (陽) | outward-facing form of: reflective, adaptive, communicative | 

癸 (guǐ) | 水 water | yin (陰) | inward-facing form of: reflective, adaptive, communicative | 

The stems run in element pairs: 甲乙 wood, 丙丁 fire, 戊己 earth, 庚辛 metal and 壬癸 water, yang first and yin second. If you know your element, only the polarity is left to pin down, and the pair shares its trait text in the engine.

Two cautions apply. A stem is one character of eight, so the Day Master describes a starting temperament and not a verdict. And two people with the same Day Master can read very differently, because strength and favourable elements depend on the other seven characters.

## How is Day Master strength judged?

Strength asks whether the Day Master has enough support, or too much to carry. The engine follows the 旺相休囚死 framework from the 三命通會 tradition together with 通根 (rooting).

- Season. The month branch gives the Day Master one of five states, 旺 (prosperous), 相 (assisting), 休 (resting), 囚 (confined) or 死 (dead).

- Roots. A stem is rooted (通根) when branches in the chart carry its own element. Roots keep a seasonally weak Day Master from collapsing.

- Support against drain. Characters of the same element or the element that produces it count as support. Characters that exhaust, control or consume it count as drain.

- A numeric score. The engine combines these into one signed score (method note). Negative means weak (身弱), positive means strong (身強).

The strength verdict then drives the 用神, the favourable elements. The engine uses four techniques, 扶抑 (support and restrain), 調候 (climate), 通關 (bridging) and 病藥 (disease and remedy), and cites which one fired.

## What does a worked chart look like?

The sample person is 王大明, male, born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore. His pillars are 戊辰 (year), 乙卯 (month), 己巳 (day) and 戊辰 (hour). The day stem is 己, so his Day Master is yin earth, the soft, absorbing form of earth. The engine's trait text for earth reads steady, reliable, grounding.

The engine rates him 身弱 (weak) with a score of -0.97. The season state is 死, because earth is dead in a wood month, and the chart has roots 辰巳辰. The support total is 6.33 against a drain of 3.67, and the engine's score of -0.97 is its weighted result (method note).

For a weak Day Master, the favourable elements are 火 and 土, and the unfavourable ones are 木, 水 and 金. The matching colours are 紅, 紫, 黃 and 棕. The citations on that conclusion are 扶抑法 (technique 1 of 4) and 調候法 (technique 2 of 4). The same weak verdict feeds the Ten Gods reading in the ten gods guide.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia births?

Three practical details decide which stem you end up with.

- Clock time is not solar time. For 王大明 the correction is 74 minutes, from 09:30 to 08:16. The engine works from the corrected time, so always enter the clock time that was on the wall, plus the place.

- Pre-1982 births. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and on UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used MYT, UTC+8, since 1982-01-01. Use the clock that applied on the birth date.

- Year boundary. The year pillar turns at 立春, not at Chinese New Year. In 2027 that is 2027-02-04, so a late-January or early-February birth may belong to the earlier year.

If you are unsure of the hour, a good reading says which of its findings depend on it. The hour pillar contributes to the strength score and to the Ten Gods distribution, so those are the findings to treat with care when the birth time is a guess.

## Sources and method

- Ten stems, polarity and elements: the stem table in the engine, ten stems in five element pairs.

- Trait clauses: the engine's per-element trait text plus a polarity label (method note), not a classical per-stem table.

- Strength: the 旺相休囚死 and 通根 framework, with a numeric score (method note).

- Favourable elements: the four 用神 techniques 扶抑, 調候, 通關 and 病藥, with 三命通會 as the classical source for stem relationships.

- Time: the 子平 true-solar-time convention, with the UTC+7:30 and UTC+8 Singapore offsets.

Find your own Day Master, strength and favourable elements with the free reading at /start.

# Eight House (八宅) Directions: Your Kua and All Eight Direction Scores

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/eight-house-directions
Updated: 2026-10-08

Fengshui

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-08
Eight House (八宅) is a feng shui method that starts from the person, not the building. Your birth year and sex give a life gua (命卦, "kua"), one of eight trigrams, and the 八宅大遊年 table turns that kua into a quality for each of the eight compass directions: four auspicious, four inauspicious, each with an engine score.

## What is a kua, and which group are you in?

The kua comes from the birth year, using the 立春 boundary and separate formulas for men and women. The eight kua then fall into two families. East group (東四命) is 坎, 離, 震 and 巽. West group (西四命) is 乾, 坤, 艮 and 兌. People in the same group share the same four good directions, though not the same ranking of them. Find your own number with the free Kua number calculator.

The ranking is pure lookup: Table 1 below is the full 八宅大遊年 grid as the engine holds it.

Key facts

- The 8 kua split into an East group (坎, 離, 震, 巽) and a West group (乾, 坤, 艮, 兌).
- The engine scores the 8 qualities from 生氣 at +3.0 down to 絕命 at -3.0.
- The sample person, 王大明 (born 1988-03-15), has kua 震, East group.
- For kua 震 the best direction is 離 (south) at 生氣, and the worst is 兌 (west) at 絕命.
- In 2027 the annual 五黃 star sits in 坎, the north, and 立春 2027-02-04 starts that year.
- The engine cites the grid to 八宅大遊年, the 八宅明鏡 tradition.

The eight trigrams around a compass, coloured in East group and West group, showing which four directions each group favours

## What are the eight directions worth?

The engine scores the qualities as 生氣 +3.0, 天醫 +2.5, 延年 +2.0, 伏位 +1.0, 禍害 -1.0, 六煞 -1.5, 五鬼 -2.0 and 絕命 -3.0 (method note: these are the engine's weights, not a classical table). 生氣 is vitality, the strongest choice for a headboard, desk or main door. 天醫 is health, 延年 is steady support, and 伏位 is the calm home position.

## Which direction is which for each kua?

Read across the row for your kua. The column head names the trigram and its compass direction, and each cell gives the quality and its score.

Table 1: quality and score of each direction, by life gua

Life gua | 坎 N | 離 S | 震 E | 巽 SE | 乾 NW | 坤 SW | 艮 NE | 兌 W | 

坎 (東四) | 伏位 +1.0 | 延年 +2.0 | 天醫 +2.5 | 生氣 +3.0 | 六煞 -1.5 | 絕命 -3.0 | 五鬼 -2.0 | 禍害 -1.0 | 

離 (東四) | 延年 +2.0 | 伏位 +1.0 | 生氣 +3.0 | 天醫 +2.5 | 絕命 -3.0 | 六煞 -1.5 | 禍害 -1.0 | 五鬼 -2.0 | 

震 (東四) | 天醫 +2.5 | 生氣 +3.0 | 伏位 +1.0 | 延年 +2.0 | 五鬼 -2.0 | 禍害 -1.0 | 六煞 -1.5 | 絕命 -3.0 | 

巽 (東四) | 生氣 +3.0 | 天醫 +2.5 | 延年 +2.0 | 伏位 +1.0 | 禍害 -1.0 | 五鬼 -2.0 | 絕命 -3.0 | 六煞 -1.5 | 

乾 (西四) | 六煞 -1.5 | 絕命 -3.0 | 五鬼 -2.0 | 禍害 -1.0 | 伏位 +1.0 | 延年 +2.0 | 天醫 +2.5 | 生氣 +3.0 | 

坤 (西四) | 絕命 -3.0 | 六煞 -1.5 | 禍害 -1.0 | 五鬼 -2.0 | 延年 +2.0 | 伏位 +1.0 | 生氣 +3.0 | 天醫 +2.5 | 

艮 (西四) | 五鬼 -2.0 | 禍害 -1.0 | 六煞 -1.5 | 絕命 -3.0 | 天醫 +2.5 | 生氣 +3.0 | 伏位 +1.0 | 延年 +2.0 | 

兌 (西四) | 禍害 -1.0 | 五鬼 -2.0 | 絕命 -3.0 | 六煞 -1.5 | 生氣 +3.0 | 天醫 +2.5 | 延年 +2.0 | 伏位 +1.0 | 

Every kua has 伏位 in the direction of its own trigram, and the four auspicious cells in a row all lie in that kua's own group.

## What is your kua by birth year?

Find your birth year and read across. The pattern repeats every 9 years. People born in January or early February before 立春 use the previous year's row.

## What does a worked example show?

王大明 was born 1988-03-15 as a man, and the table gives him kua 震, East group (東四命). Row 震 in Table 1 reads: 離 (south) 生氣 +3.0, 坎 (north) 天醫 +2.5, 巽 (southeast) 延年 +2.0 and 震 (east) 伏位 +1.0. His bad directions are 坤 (southwest) 禍害 -1.0, 艮 (northeast) 六煞 -1.5, 乾 (northwest) 五鬼 -2.0 and 兌 (west) 絕命 -3.0.

In 2027 the annual flying star 5 (五黃) sits in 坎, the north. For 王大明 that is his 天醫 direction at +2.5, so a bedroom or desk in the north would sit under an annual affliction in a good direction. The two are separate layers (see Flying Stars 2027). The 2027 年神 positions are 太歲 at 未 (SW1, 202.5-217.5 degrees), 歲破 at 丑 (NE1, 22.5-37.5 degrees) and 三煞 in the west, 232.5-307.5 degrees.

## How do you apply it in an HDB flat or condo in Singapore or Malaysia?

Eight House is applied to rooms and to the entrance, so the first step is a bearing, not a mood.

- Take the main door as the facing. In an HDB flat or condominium unit the facing is conventionally taken from the unit's main door, outward. Measure the bearing in degrees.

- Set the bed head and the desk. Point the head of the bed toward a good direction for the sleeper, and seat the desk so the sitter faces one. A couple whose kua lie in different groups share no good direction, because the two groups use four different directions each.

- Check the annual layer. The 2027 year starts at 立春, 2027-02-04, so the 五黃 north sector counts from that date.

- Enter the birth year correctly. A birth in January or early February can belong to the earlier year.

## Sources and method

- Kua by birth year and sex: the engine's year table with the 立春 year boundary of the 子平 calendar.

- East and West groups: the engine's grouping of the eight kua, 坎離震巽 and 乾坤艮兌 (method note).

- Direction qualities: the 八宅大遊年 trigram line transformation, 八宅明鏡 tradition.

- Scores for each quality: the engine's own weights (method note).

- 2027 annual star and 年神: the engine's annual chart and the 協紀辨方書 年神 position rules.

# The Five Elements in a BaZi Chart: Balance, the 生克 Cycles, and What Excess Means

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/five-elements-cycles
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-19 Updated 2026-10-09
BaZi treats a chart as a five-element ecosystem of 木 wood, 火 fire, 土 earth, 金 metal and 水 water. Every stem, branch and hidden stem carries one element, and a weighted count of all of them gives the chart's element balance.

## How are the five elements counted in a chart?

The engine gives each stem, including the Day Master, a weight of 1.0. Each branch adds 1.0 for its main hidden stem and one third for each minor hidden stem (method note). It then adds the weights per element. The sample chart is 王大明, a fictional man born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore, with pillars 戊辰 乙卯 己巳 戊辰 and Day Master 己.

His weights total 10.0: Wood 2.67, Fire 1.0, Earth 5.33, Metal 0.33 and Water 0.67. As shares, Earth is 53.3 %, Wood 26.7 %, Fire 10.0 %, Water 6.7 % and Metal 3.3 %. The habit that matters most is to read these as balance, not as a score. The tallest bar is the heaviest influence, not the best one, and the shortest bar is where the ecosystem is thin.

Key facts

- The five elements are 木, 火, 土, 金 and 水, and every stem and branch belongs to one of them.
- The feeding cycle (生) runs 木→火→土→金→水→木, and the controlling cycle (剋) runs 木→土→水→火→金→木.
- The sample's weights are Wood 2.67, Fire 1.0, Earth 5.33, Metal 0.33 and Water 0.67, totalling 10.0.
- In shares, 土 is 53.3 % and 金 is only 3.3 %, which the engine bands as absent.
- The engine finds two frictions: 土 over 水, and 木 over 土.
- The favourable elements are 火 and 土 (扶抑法 and 調候法), with colours 紅, 紫, 黃 and 棕.

Diagram of the five elements 木 火 土 金 水 showing the generating cycle 生 and the controlling cycle 剋
Table 1: the five elements and their engine traits

Element | Engine trait | Organs the engine lists | Sample share | 

木 Wood | pioneering, growth-driven, initiating | liver, gallbladder | 26.7 % | 

火 Fire | expressive, social, leadership-leaning | heart, small intestine | 10.0 % | 

土 Earth | steady, reliable, grounding | spleen, stomach | 53.3 % | 

金 Metal | structured, precise, disciplined | lungs, large intestine | 3.3 % | 

水 Water | reflective, adaptive, communicative | kidneys, bladder | 6.7 % | 

The organ column is a traditional reference layer, not medical advice. Section five returns to it.

## How do the two cycles work?

The elements interact along two fixed cycles. In the feeding cycle (相生), each element generates the next. Wood feeds fire, fire makes earth, earth bears metal, metal carries water, and water nourishes wood. In the controlling cycle (相剋), each element checks another, the way a dam checks a river.

Both cycles are neutral machinery. Control is structure, not harm. Trouble appears when weights are lopsided. A very heavy element crushes the one it controls, which is a friction. A very weak element cannot feed the one downstream of it, which is a gap. The engine attaches a fixed sentence to each pair.

Table 2: the cycle pairs and the engine's wording

Pair | Cycle | Engine meaning | 

木 to 火 | feeds | ideas and growth fuel expression | 

火 to 土 | feeds | action settles into stability and routine | 

土 to 金 | feeds | routine sharpens discipline and follow-through | 

金 to 水 | feeds | structure deepens insight and adaptability | 

水 to 木 | feeds | reflection feeds growth and initiative | 

木 over 土 | controls | growth overruns stability, plans trample routines | 

土 over 水 | controls | caution dams flow, communication and adaptability get blocked | 

水 over 火 | controls | overthinking damps enthusiasm and visibility | 

火 over 金 | controls | urgency melts discipline, structure gives way under passion | 

金 over 木 | controls | structure prunes growth, rules and rigidity cut initiative | 

A friction is a recurring theme, not an event. Once it is named, it can be managed, usually by strengthening a buffer element that drains the aggressor and feeds the victim.

## What are the five roles around your Day Master?

Relative to your Day Master, the other four elements take fixed roles. The element that feeds you is your resource (印). The one you produce is your output (食傷). The one you control is your wealth (財). The one that controls you is your pressure or authority (官殺). Your own element is your peers (比劫).

For the sample, the Day Master 己 is Earth, so the roles fall as follows.

Table 3: element roles for Day Master 己

Role | Element | Share | Band | Engine meaning | 

Peers 比劫 | 土 | 53.3 % | heavy | self-strength, siblings, competition | 

Pressure 官殺 | 木 | 26.7 % | heavy | discipline, career pressure, external structure | 

Resource 印 | 火 | 10.0 % | present | support, learning, protection, your recharge line | 

Wealth 財 | 水 | 6.7 % | faint | results the chart can seize and hold | 

Output 食傷 | 金 | 3.3 % | absent | expression and output, spends your energy | 

These five roles are what the ten gods refine one level further. The element wheel and the ten-god chart are the same picture at two zoom levels.

## What does the sample chart's balance mean?

The engine writes its findings as short sentences, each tied to a cycle. For the sample it reports five.

- 土 dominates at 53.3 %, so steady, reliable, grounding colours the whole chart, and its excesses are the first faults to watch.

- 金 is effectively absent at 3.3 %, so structure and follow-through need deliberate effort. The chain into 水 also loses its feeder.

- 土 at 53.3 % bears down on weak 水 at 6.7 %, so caution dams flow and communication gets blocked.

- 木 at 26.7 % stands against 土 at 53.3 %, so growth overruns stability. The engine calls this a recurring theme, manageable once named.

- The support line is intact: 火 at 10.0 % feeds 土, so help and recovery are structurally available.

Absence has a fixed cost in the engine's wording. A missing 金 means structure and follow-through need deliberate effort. A missing 木 would mean initiative and fresh starts need deliberate effort. A missing 水 would mean adaptability and communication need deliberate effort. None of these is a curse. Each marks a job that does not run on autopilot.

## How do elements map to health and daily choices?

Traditional five-element medicine links each element to organ systems. The engine marks a very weak or very heavy element as a system worth caring for. In the sample, 土 is flagged as excess (過旺), covering spleen, stomach, digestion and overthinking. 金 and 水 are flagged as weak (不足), covering lungs, skin, kidneys and bones. Wood and Fire are balanced. This is a reference layer and never medical advice.

The practical levers are gentler. The engine judges the Day Master weak (身弱, score -0.97), so its medicine feeds and protects: 火 and 土. These translate into colours (紅, 紫, 黃, 棕), room sectors and work settings. The favourable elements guide explains that step.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

The element count depends on the four pillars, so anything that shifts a pillar shifts the balance.

- Year boundary. The BaZi year turns at 立春, which falls on 2027-02-04 in 2027. A birth in late January or early February may belong to the previous year, with a different year pillar and a different count.

- Time zone. Singapore used UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. A wrong offset can move the hour pillar and change two of the eight characters.

- True solar time. The engine converts the clock to true solar time. The sample's 09:30 became 08:16 before the hour pillar was cast.

- Homes. For an HDB flat or condominium unit, element advice applies to what you control, such as the colour of a study wall or bedding. You do not need to renovate.

## Sources and method

- Cycles: the 五行生剋 cycles, applied to the chart's weighted element balance.

- Weights and bands: the engine's own weighting and band thresholds (method note).

- Frictions and absences: the engine's fixed sentences for each pair, listed in Table 2.

- Favourable elements: 扶抑法 and 調候法, two of the four 用神 methods.

- Health map: a traditional organ correspondence, offered as reference only (method note).

- Strength framework: 旺相休囚死 with 通根.

Find your own element balance in the free reading at /start, and see how the roles become gods in ten gods explained.

# Flying Stars 2027 (丁未年): Annual Chart, 太歲 and 五黃 for SG and MY Homes

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/flying-stars-2027
Updated: 2026-10-08

Flying Stars

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-08
Flying stars (玄空飛星) are a feng shui method that places nine numbered stars across the centre and eight compass sectors of a building, and re-deals the annual stars every year at 立春. In 2027, a 丁未 year, star 9 enters the centre and the 五黃 star 5 sits in the north.

## What does the 2027 annual chart look like?

The annual chart is the same for every building on earth: it depends only on the year, not on your address. What differs is which of your rooms falls in which sector. The engine that powers our home readings gives this distribution for 2027.

The 2027 annual flying-star grid: 9 in the centre, 1 northwest, 2 west, 3 northeast, 4 south, 5 north, 6 southwest, 7 east, 8 southeast
Palace | Direction | Star | Element | Quality in the engine (period 9) | 

中 | centre | 9 | 火 | 當運旺星, score +2.0 | 

乾 | NW | 1 | 水 | 生氣星 (next period), +1.5 | 

兌 | W | 2 | 土 | 二黑 病符, illness star, -1.5 | 

艮 | NE | 3 | 木 | 三碧 是非, conflict star, -1.0 | 

離 | S | 4 | 木 | 平星, 0.0 | 

坎 | N | 5 | 土 | 五黃 廉貞, most afflictive, -2.0 | 

坤 | SW | 6 | 金 | 吉白星, +0.5 | 

震 | E | 7 | 金 | 平星, 0.0 | 

巽 | SE | 8 | 土 | 退氣星, -0.5 | 

Key facts

- The 2027 annual chart starts at 立春 on 2027-02-04 and runs to 立春 on 2028-02-04.
- Star 9 is in the centre and star 5 (五黃) is in the north palace 坎.
- The 太歲 sits at 未, southwest, in the 202.5° to 217.5° arc.
- The 歲破 sits at 丑, northeast, in the 22.5° to 37.5° arc.
- The 三煞 occupy the west frame 申酉戌, the arc from 232.5° to 307.5°.
- The 五黃 scores -2.0 in the engine, the lowest of the nine stars.

## When does the flying-star year change?

At 立春, 2027-02-04, not on 1 January and not at Chinese New Year. A condo owner who finishes a renovation on 2 February 2027 is still working in the 丙午 year, with a different chart. The year pillar shows the switch: a date of 2027-01-20 carries 丙午, and 2027-02-10 carries 丁未.

The centre star moves one step each year. In 2026 the centre star is 1, in 2027 it is 9 and in 2028 it is 8. The 五黃 therefore travels: south (離) in 2026, north (坎) in 2027 and southwest (坤) in 2028. Anything you plan across the 4 February boundary should be checked against both charts.

## Which annual afflictions apply in 2027?

Three year-spirits (年神) rotate with the year branch, and they are separate from the numbered stars. These positions are derived from the 年神 rules in 協紀辨方書 (method note: the engine's public output is the star chart, and these three are derived from the rules for the 丁未 year).

- 太歲 (Grand Duke) sits on the year branch. For 未 that is southwest, the arc SW1.

- 歲破 (Year Breaker) sits on the branch opposite the year branch. Opposite 未 is 丑, northeast, the arc NE1.

- 三煞 (Three Killings) for a 亥卯未 year sit on the opposite frame: the west, 申酉戌. That is SW3, W2 and NW1 in the 24-mountain ring.

Together with the north 五黃, the sectors to treat carefully in 2027 are southwest, northeast, the western arc and north. For the 五黃 sector itself the engine's remedy table gives the traditional answer: place metal there (brass, a six-coin string or a metal pendulum clock) to drain the earth star, and keep it quiet (method note: engine remedy table). The practical rule is the traditional one: avoid structural work that breaks the ground or the wall (動土) in those sectors during the year. Assembling flat-pack furniture is not 動土; hacking tiles, hacking walls and drilling for new points is.

## How do I read the chart for an HDB flat or condo?

Use the unit plan, not the block. Stand inside the unit at the main door looking out; that direction is the facing. Then overlay the nine-palace grid on the floor plan of your own unit, with north at the real compass north, and see which rooms fall in which palace. Neighbouring units in the same block face the same way but have different room layouts, so their palace map differs.

Two Singapore and Malaysia points matter in practice. First, a single flat can put its rooms in three or four different palaces, so the annual chart is read room by room and not for the flat as a whole. Second, a condo unit with a glass balcony wall has a clear facing but a looser boundary, so the room outline you trace in the tool decides which palace the balcony belongs to.

## What does a worked example show?

Take the fictional 王大明, born 1988-03-15, kua 震, East group. His Eight House map says his 生氣 direction is south (離), his 天醫 is north (坎), his 延年 is southeast (巽), and east (震) is 伏位, the stable seat.

Now overlay 2027:

- South, his best direction, carries the annual 4, a neutral 平星 at 0.0. The sector stays usable and loses nothing; it just gains no annual boost.

- North, his 天醫 direction, carries 五黃 at -2.0. A study or bed that relies on that wall is working against the annual star for this year. The natal and personal layers still count, but the year layer is the heaviest single annual penalty.

- East, his 伏位 seat, carries the neutral 7.

- Southwest holds both the 太歲 and the annual 6, a favourable 吉白星 at +0.5. The 太歲 is the more specific warning for ground-breaking, so the rule is to keep it free of structural work even though the star is kind.

The conclusion is not "move out" or "avoid north". It is the overlay: in 2027, keep construction away from north, northeast, southwest and the west frame, and check the sleeping direction against the form rules in the bed direction guide.

## Why are annual stars a layer and not the whole story?

The annual chart sits on top of the building's natal chart, which comes from its facing and construction period under 沈氏玄空學, including the 替卦 replacement stars used for 兼向 facings. It also sits above your personal Eight House directions from 八宅. A sector can be natal-strong and annually afflicted, or the reverse. The reading that matters is the overlay of all three, and each layer should show the rule that produced it.

The home tool computes all three layers for a plan you trace and produces a renovation-timing table with each rule cited. Use it to see which of your rooms fall in the 2027 afflicted sectors.

## Sources and method

- Annual star chart: the nine-star flying order with the centre star set at each 立春; the engine's output, listed in the table above.

- Star qualities in period 9: the engine's own scoring of each star (method note), not a classical table.

- 太歲, 歲破 and 三煞 positions: the 年神 position rules of 協紀辨方書, applied to the 丁未 year branch.

- Natal chart and 替卦: 沈氏玄空學, on the 兼向 replacement stars.

- Personal directions in the worked example: 八宅大遊年, the 八宅明鏡 tradition.

- Year boundary: 立春 as the solar term that opens the year in the 子平 calendar.

Trace your own floor plan in the home tool at /fengshui, or begin with the free personal reading at /start.

# How to Read a Four Pillars Chart: Stems, Branches, Hidden Stems and the Four Palaces

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/four-pillars-explained
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-19 Updated 2026-10-09
A BaZi chart (四柱八字) is a grid of eight characters. Each of the year, month, day and hour of birth gets a heavenly stem (天干) and an earthly branch (地支). The stem of the day pillar is the Day Master (日主), and every other character in the chart is read in relation to it.

## What is in each of the four pillars?

Each pillar is a pair of characters. The stem sits on top and the branch sits underneath. The ten stems are 甲 乙 丙 丁 戊 己 庚 辛 壬 癸. The twelve branches are 子 丑 寅 卯 辰 巳 午 未 申 酉 戌 亥. Every stem and every branch belongs to one of the five elements, and each is yin or yang.

The sample person here is 王大明, a fictional man born on 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore. His pillars are 戊辰 (year), 乙卯 (month), 己巳 (day) and 戊辰 (hour). His Day Master is 己, yin Earth. Everything below uses this one chart, so you can follow each step without switching examples.

The stem is the visible, declared part of a pillar. The branch is its foundation. A branch also hides one to three further stems inside it, which the next section covers. The year branch carries the zodiac animal most people know their birth year by.

Key facts

- A chart has 4 pillars and 8 characters, and each pillar is one stem plus one branch.
- The sample chart is 戊辰 乙卯 己巳 戊辰, with Day Master 己 (yin Earth).
- The four palaces cover ages 0-15 (year), 16-32 (month), 33-48 (day) and 49+ (hour).
- Branch 辰 hides 戊, 乙 and 癸, branch 卯 hides 乙, and branch 巳 hides 丙, 庚 and 戊.
- The engine rates the Day Master 身弱 (weak), with a score of -0.97 and roots in 辰, 巳 and 辰.
- The clock time 09:30 becomes true solar time 08:16 before the pillars are cast.

Four pillars grid for the sample chart showing year, month, day and hour with stems, branches and hidden stems, and the Day Master 己 marked
Table 1: the sample chart, pillar by pillar

Pillar | Stem | Branch | Branch element | Hidden stems | Stem god | 

Year 年柱 | 戊 | 辰 | 土 | 戊, 乙, 癸 | 劫財 | 

Month 月柱 | 乙 | 卯 | 木 | 乙 | 七殺 | 

Day 日柱 | 己 | 巳 | 火 | 丙, 庚, 戊 | 日主 (Day Master) | 

Hour 時柱 | 戊 | 辰 | 土 | 戊, 乙, 癸 | 劫財 | 

The stem god column shows each stem's relation to the Day Master. Those relations are the ten gods. The Day Master itself is the reference point, so it carries no god.

## What are hidden stems, and why do they matter?

Hidden stems (藏干) are the extra stems stored inside a branch. A chart that looks thin in one element on the surface may carry it below. This is why any serious element count includes them. The engine lists the hidden stems for all twelve branches in Table 2.

Table 2: hidden stems in the twelve branches

Branch | Element | Hidden stems | 

子 | 水 | 癸 | 

丑 | 土 | 己, 癸, 辛 | 

寅 | 木 | 甲, 丙, 戊 | 

卯 | 木 | 乙 | 

辰 | 土 | 戊, 乙, 癸 | 

巳 | 火 | 丙, 庚, 戊 | 

午 | 火 | 丁, 己 | 

未 | 土 | 己, 丁, 乙 | 

申 | 金 | 庚, 壬, 戊 | 

酉 | 金 | 辛 | 

戌 | 土 | 戊, 辛, 丁 | 

亥 | 水 | 壬, 甲 | 

In the sample, the Day Master 己 is Earth. Its branches 辰, 巳 and 辰 each hide the Earth stem 戊, so the engine records a root (通根) in all three. A Day Master with no visible peers can still be rooted this way.

The engine weights every visible stem and every hidden stem. Its element totals add up to 10.0: Wood 2.67, Fire 1.0, Earth 5.33, Metal 0.33 and Water 0.67. Earth is 53.3 % of the chart, and Metal is only 3.3 %. The weights come from a fixed rule, so two honest tools should return the same figures.

## How do the four pillars become four palaces?

Classical doctrine reads the same four columns a second way, as the four palaces (宮位). The palace tells you which area of life a character colours and roughly which stage of life it speaks to. Table 3 gives the ages and the sample's reading.

Table 3: the four palaces in the sample chart

Palace | Ages | Governs | Sample reading | 

Year | 0-15 | ancestry, childhood, first impressions | stem god 劫財, hides 劫財, 七殺, 偏財 | 

Month | 16-32 | parents, early adulthood, career headquarters | stem god 七殺, hides 七殺 | 

Day | 33-48 | the self (stem), spouse and home (branch) | branch 巳 hosts 正印, 傷官, 劫財 | 

Hour | 49+ | children, late-life luck, side pursuits | stem god 劫財, hides 劫財, 七殺, 偏財 | 

The ten gods say what an energy is. The palace says where it plays out and when it tends to peak. The sample's career headquarters is 七殺-flavoured, which the engine reads as raw pressure and discipline imposed from outside. The spouse palace 巳 is rated undisturbed, a stable seat for the marriage, and it hosts 正印, 傷官 and 劫財.

The children line reads differently. The hour palace carries 劫財, 劫財, 七殺 and 偏財, and output stars sit at only 3.7 %. The engine's wording is that the bond builds through deliberate time, not shared projects. Treat that as a traditional reading of structure, not a forecast.

## How is the chart judged from the Day Master?

Once the pillars are cast, the first judgement is whether the Day Master is strong or weak. The engine uses a four-step method, shown here for the sample.

- Season (得令). The month branch 卯 is Wood, and Wood controls Earth, so the season state is 死 (月令剋我). This scores -2.0.

- Support. Peers (比劫) of Earth weigh 5.33 and resource (印) of Fire weighs 1.0, so support is 6.33.

- Drain. Output, wealth and authority combined weigh 3.67.

- Root. The Day Master is rooted (有根) in 辰, 巳 and 辰.

The result is 身弱, a weak Day Master, with a score of -0.97 in an ordinary (正格) structure. The engine then picks its favourable elements, Fire and Earth, using two of the four 用神 methods: 扶抑法 (support or drain) and 調候法 (seasonal climate). Strength is a measure of balance, not of ability. It only decides which elements act as medicine for this chart.

One caveat belongs here (method note). The engine reads the month by the branch's own element. The 旺相休囚死 school reads it by the season's element, and the two can differ in the days around a season change.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

Three details decide whether your pillars match the sample's logic.

- Year boundary. The BaZi year turns at 立春, not on 1 January or Chinese New Year. In 2027, 立春 falls on 2027-02-04. The engine casts 丙午 as the year pillar for 2027-01-20 and 丁未 for 2027-02-10. A Singapore or Malaysia birth in late January or early February needs a check against the exact moment.

- Time zone. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. A birth certificate time before 1982 must be read with the older offset.

- True solar time. The engine converts clock time to true solar time using longitude and the equation of time. The sample's 09:30 becomes 08:16, using longitude 103.8517°E and an equation of time of -9.4 minutes. A birth close to an hour boundary can change the hour pillar.

If you are unsure of the birth hour, run the chart with a few candidate times and see whether the hour pillar changes. If it does not, the doubt does not matter for the pillars.

## Sources and method

- Pillar structure: the 子平 convention of year, month, day and hour pillars, cast on true solar time.

- Hidden stems and branch elements: the engine's fixed tables, shown in Table 2.

- Palace doctrine: the four-palace ages and areas, as the engine's palace text states them (method note).

- Strength method: the 旺相休囚死 and 通根 framework, with 扶抑法 and 調候法 for the favourable elements.

- Stem relations: 三命通會, in the chapters the engine cites.

- Year boundary: the 立春 date taken from the engine's solar-term calculation.

Cast your own four pillars in the free reading at /start, then see what each stem is called in ten gods explained.

# How Chinese Baby Names Are Scored: 用神, 五格, 三才, Meaning, Sound and Gender

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/how-chinese-baby-names-are-scored
Updated: 2026-10-08

Naming

By BaziMaster 2026-10-08 Updated 2026-10-08
A Chinese baby name score is a 100-point total built from seven checked parts: the child's favourable element (用神), the five grids (五格), the three talents (三才), meaning, sound, gender fit and data confidence. Each part has a fixed weight, so the final grade can be traced back to the rule behind every point.

## How is a name scored out of 100?

A name is rarely good or bad on one test. A character can carry the right element, have an excellent stroke count and still sound like something embarrassing. The builder at bazifor.me therefore scores seven parts, weights them, and adds them up. Nothing is hidden: the weights below are the ones the engine uses.

Part | Weight | What it checks | 

用神 | 30 | Does each character carry an element the child's chart needs? | 

五格 | 25 | Are the five stroke-count grids lucky or unlucky? | 

三才 | 15 | Do the elements of the heaven, person and earth grids support each other? | 

字义 | 10 | What do the characters mean, in 16 meaning categories? | 

音韵 | 5 | Do the tones and sounds read well, and do they collide with a bad word? | 

性别 | 5 | Does the name fit the child's gender, using character tags? | 

可信度 | 10 | How far can the engine trust the data behind the other parts? | 

The seven weights add up to 100. The sum of the weights is the highest total a name can reach.

Key facts

- The seven weights are 用神 30, 五格 25, 三才 15, 字义 10, 音韵 5, 性别 5 and 可信度 10.
- The grade bands are 90 and above 上佳, 80 and above 佳, 65 and above 可, and below 65 待斟酌.
- A strong sound hit (an English profanity, a homophone or a severe homophone) caps the grade at 待斟酌 whatever the total.
- The sound layer is backed by 303 sound-alike entries, of which 79 are severe, and 72 English reading checks.
- 478 characters carry meaning tags, in 16 meaning categories, and 171 characters carry gender tags.
- Strokes follow the 康熙字典 count, which uses the traditional form of each character.

## Why does 用神 carry the most weight?

Because it is the part that comes from the child, not from the name. The 用神 is the element the child's BaZi chart needs most, chosen by 扶抑, 調候, 通關 and 病藥. See what a useful god is for how it is found. A character carries an element, and the engine gives each character a role score against the child's chart:

- 用神 (the useful god): 1.0

- 喜 (favourable): 0.7

- 闲 (neutral) or 未定 (undetermined): 0.3

- 忌 (unfavourable): 0.0

The 30 points scale with these role scores (method note: the exact blending across characters is the engine's). That is why the child's birth moment matters for naming. The chart behind the 用神 depends on true solar time. For a birth in Singapore or Malaysia the clock is UTC+8 (UTC+7:30 in Singapore before 1982), and a birth near a two-hour boundary can change the hour pillar and with it the 用神. The year changes at 立春, so a late January or early February birth may belong to the previous year.

## How do the five grids (五格) work?

The 五格 are five numbers derived from the stroke counts of the surname and given name: the 天格 (heaven), 人格 (person), 地格 (earth), 外格 (outer) and 總格 (total) grids. Each number is looked up in the 81-number system (81數理), which marks it 吉 or 凶. This is a modern naming-school convention, not a classical rule, and the engine uses only the two-state 吉/凶 reading (method note).

Stroke counts come from the 康熙字典. This matters because the dictionary uses the traditional form: 祿 has more strokes than the simplified 禄, so a name typed in simplified Chinese must be counted in its traditional form.

The 25 points are split across the grids by name length:

Name type | 人格 | 地格 | 總格 | 外格 | Total | 

双名 (two-character given name) | 8 | 7 | 7 | 3 | 25 | 

单名 (one-character given name) | 15 | 10 | not scored | not scored | 25 | 

The 天格 is not scored in either layout: it comes from the surname alone, so no choice of given name changes it (method note).

## Which element relations count in the 三才?

The 三才 (three talents) are the elements of the 天格, 人格 and 地格. The engine reads the relation between the elements and gives each relation a factor:

Relation | Factor | 

生 (one generates the next) | 1.0 | 

比 (same element) | 0.8 | 

洩 (drain) | 0.4 | 

人剋 (the person element restrains) | 0.2 | 

被剋 (the person element is restrained) | 0.0 | 

The 15 points scale with these factors. The relations follow the five-element generating and restraining cycles shown below.

The five-element generating and restraining cycles used to read the 三才 relations: wood feeds fire, fire feeds earth, earth feeds metal, metal feeds water, water feeds wood

## How does the sound layer work?

The sound part is worth 5 points and starts from a full score. It subtracts penalties for patterns that make a name awkward to say, and for collisions with other words. The penalties are the engine's own (method note):

Pattern | Penalty | 

Same tone repeated | 0.4 | 

Two third tones together | 0.2 | 

Ending on a neutral tone | 0.2 | 

Same syllable repeated | 0.4 | 

Reduplication | 0.1 | 

Same initial | 0.2 | 

Same final | 0.2 | 

Cap on all repeat penalties together | 0.4 | 

Near-homophone of a bad word | 0.5 | 

Tone-different homophone | 0.7 | 

Homophone | 1.0 | 

Severe homophone | 1.0 | 

English tease | 0.5 | 

English profanity | 1.0 | 

Sound-alike checks run against 303 dictionary entries (79 of them severe) and 72 English reading checks. Three kinds of hit are strong: an English profanity, a homophone, and a severe homophone. A strong hit does more than lose points. It caps the grade at 待斟酌 whatever the total, because a name that sounds like a swear word is not rescued by lucky strokes. Weaker hits, such as a near-homophone or an English tease, only cost points.

## What does the meaning and gender layer add?

The 字义 part (10 points) looks up each character in a table of 478 tagged characters across 16 meaning categories. The result also produces a short interpretation of the name, written from those tags. The 性别 part (5 points) uses 171 gender tags, which check the name against the child's gender.

## What does a worked example look like?

Take the fictional girl's name 王禄婷 (traditional 王祿婷), for a child born on 2026-03-15 at 09:30.

- Strokes (康熙字典): 王 4, 祿 13, 婷 12.

- Five grids: 天格 5 (土), 人格 17 (金), 地格 25 (土), 外格 13 (火), 總格 29 (水). All five read 吉, so 五格 earns the full 25.

- 三才: 土 金 土. The engine's detail lines read 天土生人金 ×1.0 and 地土生人金 ×0.4, the verdict is 中, and the part earns 10.5 of 15.

- Sound: tones 2, 4, 2 (wang, lu, ting). There are no findings, so the part earns the full 5.0.

- The other parts: 用神 30.0, 字义 10.0, 性别 5.0 and 可信度 10.0.

The total is 30 + 25 + 10.5 + 10 + 5 + 5 + 10 = 95.5, which lands in the 上佳 (excellent) band. The only points lost are the 4.5 in the 三才 part. The engine's reading of the name is: 既福禄双全，又亭亭玉立, or "a name suggesting blessing and prosperity; graceful and poised."

A name scoring 89.9 would read 佳, one scoring 79 would read 可, and anything under 65 reads 待斟酌.

## How are the grades set?

Total | Grade | English | 

90 and above | 上佳 | excellent | 

80 to under 90 | 佳 | good | 

65 to under 80 | 可 | fair | 

under 65 | 待斟酌 | reconsider | 

"Reconsider" does not say the name is wrong for your family. It says the rules have found a reason to look again.

## Sources and method

- Stroke counts: the 康熙字典, in traditional character forms.

- 五格 grids and the 81 numbers: a modern naming-school convention (method note), with only the two-state 吉/凶 reading used.

- 三才 relations: the five-element generating and restraining cycles, with the factors above (method note).

- 用神: the four methods 扶抑, 調候, 通關 and 病藥, applied to the child's chart under the 子平 true-solar-time convention.

- Sound, meaning, gender and confidence parts, and the grade cap: the engine's own rules and data tables (method note), not classical sources.

Score a name for your own child in the baby name builder at /baby, with the full breakdown and the rule behind every part.

# Is BaZi Deterministic? Why We Compute Readings Instead of Chatting Them

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/is-bazi-deterministic
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-09
BaZi is deterministic in its calculation and rule-guided in its interpretation. The pillars, strength score, favourable elements, ten gods and luck cycles all follow written rules. The same birth data therefore gives the same result every time.

## Which parts of a BaZi reading are deterministic?

Most of the structure is arithmetic on a calendar. Each step has one correct answer under a stated convention, and two honest implementations should agree to the digit. Table 1 follows the sample chart through each step. The sample is 王大明, a fictional man born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore.

Key facts

- The same birth data or floor plan always gives the same result, which is claim one of the ten method claims at /method.
- Every output line names the classical rule it applies, with a rule id a practitioner can check.
- The sample's clock time 09:30 becomes true solar time 08:16, using longitude 103.8517°E and an equation of time of -9.4 minutes.
- The strength rule has four steps and returns 身弱 with a score of -0.97, from support 6.33 against drain 3.67.
- The sample's luck cycles run forward from the month pillar 乙卯 and start at age 6.7.
- No generative AI writes any reading, and the engine does not predict events.

Pipeline from birth data through true solar time, four pillars, strength, favourable elements and luck cycles to a reading in which each line cites its rule
Table 1: the sample chart, step by step

Step | Rule | Sample result | 

True solar time | clock converted by longitude and equation of time | 09:30 becomes 08:16 | 

Four pillars | solar terms, 立春 year boundary, sixty-day cycle | 戊辰 乙卯 己巳 戊辰 | 

Strength | season, support, drain, root | 身弱, score -0.97 | 

Favourable elements | 扶抑法 then 調候法 | 火 and 土 | 

Ten gods | each stem's relation to the Day Master | 劫財 48.1 %, 七殺 29.6 % | 

Luck cycles | 陽男陰女順行, 起運 = 距節日數 / 3 | forward from 乙卯, start age 6.7 | 

The 用神 step uses the four classical methods (扶抑法, 調候法, 通關, 病藥) in a defined order. For the sample, the first two produced 火 and 土 as favourable and 木, 水 and 金 as unfavourable. A different order would be a different system, which is why the order is written down.

## How does the strength rule show the idea?

The strength rule is a good test case, because it looks like judgement and is actually four fixed steps. For the sample Day Master 己 (Earth), the engine does the following.

- Season. The month branch 卯 is Wood, and Wood controls Earth, so the season state is 死, scoring -2.0.

- Support. Peers (Earth 5.33) plus resource (Fire 1.0) give 6.33.

- Drain. Output, wealth and authority combined give 3.67.

- Root. The branches 辰, 巳 and 辰 hold Earth in their hidden stems, so the Day Master is rooted.

The result is 身弱, with a score of -0.97 in an ordinary structure. Anyone can check the arithmetic by hand, which is the point. The engine prints each step with its rule id: the sample's citations list time-policy, strength-4step and dayun-direction, each tied to a named convention.

## Which parts are interpretation?

What a weak Earth Day Master with heavy authority stars means for a career is interpretation. It is still not freeform. The engine holds fixed sentence patterns for each palace and god, and fills them from the computed chart. The month palace template, for example, reads the career headquarters through the month stem's god. For the sample, that god is 七殺, which the engine words as raw pressure and discipline imposed from outside.

So the interpretive layer is written by people, in advance, and applied by rule. A sentence in a reading can be traced to a pattern, and the pattern can be argued with. That is a different thing from text produced fresh each time.

Some parts are weaker still, and the engine says so. The life-domain scores, such as learning at 70 and constitution at 26, are labelled a modern synthesis of star shares, symbolic stars and palace checks. They are rule-derived, but they are not classical doctrine (method note).

## Where do schools disagree?

The engine records its choices where traditions differ and marks the choice as disputed. The strength step shows one. The engine reads the month by the branch's own element. The 旺相休囚死 school reads it by the season's element, and the two can differ near a season change. The engine's step text names the alternative and gives an example, so the disagreement is visible in the output.

Strokes for naming follow the 康熙字典 count on the traditional form. The 81-number verdicts use a two-state scale until a finer cited table is adopted. Those are stated choices, not hidden ones.

## Why does determinism matter when choosing a tool?

A tool that generates fluent text without rules fails in three ways that a rule engine does not. These are logical points about the method, not tests of any named product (method note).

- Calendar edge cases. The 立春 boundary, true solar time and the pre-1982 Singapore clock each change a pillar. A rule engine applies them in the same order every time.

- No traceable rule. A sentence produced by pattern completion has no rule id, because no rule produced it. You cannot check it.

- Repeatability. Text generated fresh can differ on each ask. A calculation cannot, so it can be tested.

Fluency is not method. The site's method claims put it plainly: no generative AI writes any reading, and the text is rule output plus hand-written guides.

## Is deterministic the same as fatalistic?

No. The word describes the computation, not your life. The engine states that it does not predict events. It computes classical structures and states their traditional reading. A chart is a starting condition and a map of tendencies, and the readings are framed that way.

The reason to want an exact chart is practical. The actionable layers, such as colours, directions, dates and room choices, then rest on a correct starting point. A wrong hour pillar propagates into every later layer. The ten gods guide shows what a later layer does with the pillars it is given.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

Local time rules are where determinism is tested hardest.

- Year boundary. The BaZi year turns at 立春, which falls on 2027-02-04 in 2027. A late-January birth belongs to the earlier year. The engine gives year pillar 丙午 for 2027-01-20 and 丁未 for 2027-02-10.

- Time zone. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. The method page states that clock times before 1982 use the offset of that era.

- True solar time. The conversion uses longitude and the equation of time, so a Singapore birth at 09:30 is cast as 08:16.

- Homes. For an HDB flat or condominium unit, the direction and date layers take your door bearing as input. The same bearing gives the same output, which makes the result easy to check against a second tool.

## Sources and method

- Method claims: the ten claims at /method, including determinism, rule ids per line, true solar time and no generative AI (method note).

- Strength rule: 旺相休囚死 with 通根, in four steps.

- Favourable elements: the four 用神 methods, 扶抑法, 調候法, 通關 and 病藥.

- Luck cycles: 陽男陰女順行, 陰男陽女逆行, with 起運 = 距節日數 / 3.

- Time convention: the 子平 convention of true solar time.

- Stroke counts: 康熙字典.

- Interpretive text: fixed sentence patterns written in advance (method note).

Get a reading whose lines each cite a rule at /start, and see how the favourable elements are chosen in useful god colours.

# Luck Cycles (大運) and Annual Windows: The Climate and Weather of a BaZi Chart

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/luck-cycles-and-windows
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-19 Updated 2026-10-09
A birth chart is fixed, and BaZi models time with two moving layers on top of it. The luck cycles (大運) are ten-year pillars derived from the month pillar, and the annual pillar (流年) changes every 立春. The decade is the climate, and the year is the weather inside it.

## How are luck cycles worked out?

A luck cycle is a stem and branch pair that overlays the natal chart for ten years. The sequence starts from the month pillar and steps through the sixty-pair cycle. Two rules fix the direction and the start age.

The direction is 陽男陰女順行, 陰男陽女逆行. A yang-year man or a yin-year woman runs forward. A yin-year man or a yang-year woman runs backward. The start age is 起運 = 距節日數 / 3, which means the days from birth to the nearest 節 (a solar-term boundary), divided by three.

The sample is 王大明, a fictional man born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore. His pillars are 戊辰 乙卯 己巳 戊辰, and his Day Master is 己. His year stem 戊 is yang, so he runs forward from the month pillar 乙卯. The count goes to the 節 of 清明, and the start age comes out at 6.7.

Key facts

- Luck cycles step from the month pillar, forward or backward by the rule 陽男陰女順行, 陰男陽女逆行.
- The start age is 起運 = 距節日數 / 3, and the sample's is 6.7 (counted to the 節 清明).
- The sample's current decade is 己未, ages 37-47, graded growth with a score of +2.
- The weakest decade ahead is 辛酉, ages 57-67, graded corrective at -3, with a clash on the month branch 卯.
- The 2027 year pillar 丁未 starts at 立春 on 2027-02-04, with career and health cautions and a study window.
- The year 2030 (庚戌) clashes open the sample's sealed wealth vault 辰.

Timeline of the sample's eight luck cycles from age 7 to 87, each graded growth, consolidation or corrective, with the current decade marked

## How is a decade graded?

Each decade's stem and branch are read against the chart's favourable and unfavourable elements. For the sample, the favourable elements are 火 and 土, and the unfavourable are 木, 水 and 金. The engine also checks combinations and clashes between the decade branch and the natal pillars. The result is a phase label and a score.

Table 1: the sample's eight luck cycles

Pillar | Ages | Phase | Score | Why | 

丙辰 | 7-17 | growth 成長 | +2 | stem 丙 火 and branch 辰 土 favourable | 

丁巳 | 17-27 | growth 成長 | +2 | stem 丁 火 and branch 巳 火 favourable | 

戊午 | 27-37 | growth 成長 | +2 | stem 戊 土 and branch 午 火 favourable | 

己未 | 37-47 | growth 成長 | +2 | stem 己 土 and branch 未 土 favourable (current) | 

庚申 | 47-57 | consolidation 蓄勢 | -1 | both unfavourable, but 六合 with a core pillar steadies it | 

辛酉 | 57-67 | corrective 修整 | -3 | both unfavourable, and 酉 clashes month branch 卯 | 

壬戌 | 67-77 | consolidation 蓄勢 | +1 | stem 壬 unfavourable, branch 戌 favourable, 六合 steadies it | 

癸亥 | 77-87 | corrective 修整 | -3 | both unfavourable, and 亥 clashes day branch 巳 | 

The labels and scores are the engine's own (method note). Two habits keep the reading honest. First, a corrective decade is not a bad life. It is a season with different work, such as maintenance, learning and pruning. Second, each decade brings its own gods. The sample's 庚申 decade brings 傷官 on both stem and branch, a god that is nearly absent in his natal chart. The ten gods guide lists all eight pillars with their gods.

## How are annual windows read?

Within a decade, each year is checked per life area, not given one verdict. The engine looks at career, wealth, relationship, health, study and movement. Each area shows one of three flags: a window, a caution, or quiet.

A window is a tailwind and a caution is a navigation note. Neither is a prediction. The flags come from fixed rules, such as the year branch combining with or clashing a natal pillar. Table 2 shows the sample's years from 2027 to 2030.

Table 2: selected annual flags for the sample

Year | Pillar | Flags raised | 

2027 | 丁未 | career caution (合化木 feeds an unfavourable element); health caution (year feeds 土 excess); study window (偏印 arrives) | 

2028 | 戊申 | relationship caution (合化水 is unfavourable); health caution; study window; movement window (合 day branch) | 

2029 | 己酉 | career caution (酉 clashes month 卯); relationship window (桃花 year); study caution; health caution | 

2030 | 庚戌 | career window (合 month pillar); wealth window (沖開財庫 辰); study window; movement caution (clashes year branch 辰) | 

Read across a row, a year is mixed. 2030 offers a wealth window and a movement caution in the same twelve months. That is normal. The engine reports each area separately so you can plan around it.

## What are the vault, the peach blossom and other timed stars?

Some chart features exist only as timing. The wealth vault (財庫) is the storage branch of your wealth element. The sample's wealth element is 水, and its vault is 辰, which is present in his chart but sealed. A vault opens in the year whose branch clashes it. For 辰 that is any 戌 year, so 庚戌 in 2030 is flagged as a classical accumulation year.

The peach blossom (桃花) branch governs attraction years. For the sample, whose year branch 辰 sits in the 申·子·辰 group, the peach blossom branch is 酉. The 2029 year 己酉 therefore carries the relationship window. The symbolic stars guide lists the lookup tables behind these stars.

This is why two people with similar charts diverge. Their calendars strike different pillars at different ages.

## How do you use the timeline in practice?

Read the decade band first, to see where you are in the arc. Then read the current year's flags, area by area. Then plan against the next window. A short sequence works for most people.

- Find the current decade and its phase. For the sample in 2026, at age 38, it is 己未, growth.

- Check the year pillar for the year you are planning. For 2027 it is 丁未.

- Look only at the area you care about, such as career or study.

- Treat a caution as a reason to pace the decision, not to cancel it.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

The luck sequence depends on exact birth data, so local time rules matter.

- Year boundary. The annual pillar changes at 立春, not on 1 January. 立春 falls on 2026-02-04, 2027-02-04 and 2028-02-04. A birth in late January or early February may belong to the earlier year. That changes the year stem, its polarity and the direction of the luck cycles.

- Time zone. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. A wrong offset can move the birth across a 節 boundary, which changes the start age.

- Start age. The start age depends on the distance to the 節, so a birth close to a boundary can shift it by months.

- Moves. The movement flag is one input if you are changing homes. For an HDB flat or condominium unit, the move-in day itself is chosen by a separate filter, described in move-in date selection.

## Sources and method

- Luck sequence: 陽男陰女順行, 陰男陽女逆行, starting from the month pillar.

- Start age: 起運 = 距節日數 / 3.

- Decade grading: favourable and unfavourable elements from the 用神 method, plus branch combinations and clashes (method note).

- Annual flags: fixed rules on the year branch against the natal pillars (method note).

- Branch relations: 六合 and 六沖 tables as in 三命通會, in the chapters the engine cites.

- Wealth vault: the storage branch of the wealth element, opened by its clash.

See your own decade band in the free reading at /start, and compare the timeline with the stars that mark it in symbolic stars.
